title: Performance Reports
meta: See clicks, orders and revenue linked to your suggestions, in one plain English report. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Performance reports for your product recommendations
overview: You added suggestions, but are they paying for themselves? We connect to your store and recommendation tool data, then report how many shoppers saw and clicked suggestions, how many added to cart and how much revenue is linked to them. We split results by placement, so you can see what works. The report is written in plain words, with charts and clear next steps, and includes a note on how the numbers were measured.

faq: Viewer access to your store analytics and your recommendation tool, shared through their invite systems. We never ask for passwords and never change your settings while we prepare a report.
Can you prove suggestions caused the sales?
Not exactly. Linked revenue shows orders that came after a click on a suggestion, which is useful but not proof. A test, such as an A and B test, gives a firmer answer.
No. Each order covers one reporting period. If you would like a monthly report, we quote it separately after we see what data is available and how much work it takes.
What if my tool has no reporting?
We can set up simple tracking with your analytics tool or add tagged links, then report from that. For a fresh start, the report may cover a short period, and we state that clearly.
